steps.title: The Doorbell in "An Inspector Calls"
steps.body: The sharp ring cuts through the celebration. It's not just a sound - it's a dramatic interruption that changes everything. The doorbell symbolises the outside world intruding on the Birlings' comfortable existence.

steps.title: "An Inspector Calls"
steps.body: mixes both: naturalistic family drama with expressionistic Inspector who seems almost supernatural. The lighting shifts from naturalistic to expressionistic as Inspector arrives.

steps.title: Always Write About Effect on Audience
steps.body: Identifying a dramatic technique earns minimal marks. Explaining its effect on the audience is where the marks are. Every time you mention lighting, sound, stage directions, or structure, you must answer: What does the audience see, hear, or feel? How does this shape their understanding of character or theme?
